children: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $12.21B and diluted EPS of $1.06, driven by stronger Networking contribution following the Juniper merger and higher Cloud & AI selling prices versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Total net revenue”. ² Reported as “Net earnings (loss) attributable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Net Earnings (Loss) Per Share Attributable to Common Stockholders”.
Revenue growth of roughly 31–34% year-to-date/quarter was driven by Networking after the Juniper acquisition and by higher Cloud & AI average selling prices.
Channel and product mix shifted toward higher-margin Cloud & AI servers and expanded-as-a-service GreenLake offerings; Networking contribution surged post-merger.
Strategic moves included completion of the Juniper merger, divestiture of the H3C stake, launch of a cost-savings "Catalyst" program and planned Telco business divestiture.
